name: Release

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    tags: ['*']
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  source:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install build tools
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y cmake cpack

      - name: Configure CMake
        run: cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release

      - name: Build
        run: cmake --build build --config Release

      - name: Create source tarball
        run: cpack -G TBZ2 -C Release -B build

      - name: Create source zip
        run: cpack -G ZIP -C Release -B build

      - name: Upload source tarball
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: source-tar
          path: build/CPack*.tar.bz2

      - name: Upload source zip
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: source-zip
          path: build/CPack*.zip

  windows-installer:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Build Windows installer
        uses: ./.github/actions/windows-installer
        with:
          build_type: Release
          run_tests: false

      - name: Upload installer
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: windows-installer
          path: installer.exe

  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [source, windows-installer]
    if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Download source tarball
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: source-tar

      - name: Download source zip
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: source-zip

      - name: Download Windows installer
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: windows-installer

      - name: Create GitHub release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v1
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          files: |
            source-tar/*.tar.bz2
            source-zip/*.zip
            windows-installer/*.exe
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
